goals.summary: Watch def 1 (orange). [RLCS; strict tier] Air dribble from the floor: this car popped the ball off the ground (143 uu high, 0.07 s before the takeoff); 5 car touches over 2.73 s including the pop, 4 of them in the air with the ball not underneath the car. By its last air touch the car had risen to 1230 uu; a single jump from the floor peaks at 250 uu. The longest stretch with the ball within 250 uu of the car was 1.47 s, and the ball never came within 100 uu of a surface between the first air touch and the last (least 631 uu).
